# Find Your Destiny

Canonical play URL: https://kids-find-your-destiny.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/Joenasriani/kids-find-your-destiny

Find Your Destiny is a five-question fantasy result game. Each run randomly selects five questions from a fifteen-question bank, counts YES answers, maps the count to one of three result pools, and randomly selects one themed result from that pool.

The result is a game outcome, not a psychological, personality, aptitude, educational, career, or predictive assessment.
